title: NicheTarget-GNN: niche-aware graph neural networks with counterfactual perturbation for cell-state-specific target discovery in the tumor microenvironment
description: Code, simulator, analysis scripts and raw outputs for the manuscript 'Niche-Aware Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks with Counterfactual Perturbation for Discovering Cell-State-Specific Druggable Targets in the Tumor Microenvironment' (Computers in Biology and Medicine, submitted). Includes the simulation benchmark, the Xenium breast cancer and Perturb-map analyses, and per-gene scores for every method.
